<project name="ExampleProject" default="compile" basedir=".">
    
    
    <property name="src.dir" value="src"/>
    <property name="build.dir" value="build"/>

    
    <target name="init">
        <mkdir dir="${build.dir}"/>
    </target>

    <target name="compile" depends="init" if="src.dir">
        <javac srcdir="${src.dir}" destdir="${build.dir}"/>
    </target>

    
    <target name="clean" unless="skip.clean">
        <delete dir="${build.dir}"/>
    </target>

    <target name="run">
        <condition property="can.run">
            <available file="${build.dir}/Main.class"/>
        </condition>
        <echo message="Ready to run."/>
    </target>

</project>
